The last evaluated status (v2) is returned. Called from ShortComputation_f070 (0x0049F070).

operations.description: Call SessionStateCheck(this) and capture the returned status v2 as the frame gate.

Call SingleDelegationCall_a900 with the object member at obj+0x3FB8 as its argument; store the result back into v2.
Only proceed when the delegation call returned zero (interpreted as disconnected/booted status).
Only render when the byte at obj+0x30 is zero, i.e. the boot message has not already been shown this session.
Call BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aYouHaveBeenBoo, byte_5EC4CC); if it returns nonzero, the message is staged into the display buffer.

Call TextLineWrappingAndRendering with &dword_7CD204 as the resource dispatch target, byte_5EC4CC as the text, and literal arguments 3 and 16909060.
Set the byte at obj+0x30 to 1, marking the boot message as already displayed.
Return v2, the last evaluated status (session state or delegation result), propagating it to the caller.
